newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean futures end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean futures end little changed.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended little changed in slow trading on Tuesday, with most investors remaining on the sidelines, traders said.
The key January 1997 contract ended at 3,205 yuan ($386) per tonne, unchanged from Monday's close. It opened at 3,205 and stayed at that level for the whole session.
March was unchanged at 3,240, May fell four yuan to 3,325, July fell eight to 3,370 and September was unchanged at 3,400.
Combined volume fell to 11,100 tonnes from 12,900.
Traders said investors did not want to build new positions due to a lack of market-moving news.
"Most hot money flew into the stock market and other more active futures markets," one trader said.
Traders expect soybeans to continue their consolidation in the next few days.
